result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: In parseStatement, only one trailing newline is stripped (lines.pop() removes a single final empty string). A file ending with a blank line (i.e. two trailing newlines) leaves one empty string line after the pop, which is then parsed as a data row and fails assertShape since it doesn't match the header's column count. The loop (or the line-trimming logic) should skip/ignore truly blank trailing lines instead of treating them as malformed rows.

text: Done. I identified `src/ingest/parser.ts` as the responsible file: it only strips one trailing empty line from the split, so a file ending with a blank line after the last transaction leaves a stray empty string that gets parsed as a malformed row, matching the reported bug exactly.

input.title: Fix false 'Malformed row' error from trailing blank line in parser
input.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, only a single trailing newline is stripped, so a file ending with a blank line (two trailing newlines) leaves one empty-string line that gets parsed as a data row and fails assertShape. Update the trailing-line handling (or the loop) to skip/ignore truly blank trailing lines instead of treating them as malformed rows.
